Scope.domain: ECHELON 4 Player, Kinematics & Tools / Equipment Runtime Tools

TaskReconciliation.Task: Focused cutter scan found no direct live `Physics.Raycast`; live cutter keeps deferred interaction route and SHINOBU sidecar owns batch proof.
Removed cutter-adjacent ParticleSystem paths; sparks/debris are `DebrisSpawnSignal` / `VfxSparkRequestSignal` data only.

Unmanaged cutter DTOs use raw fields only; no `{ get; set; }` DTO state. Loop 24 also removed cutter-adjacent public property facades from LaserCutter/SealedDoor state readers and replaced consumers with explicit Read* methods or owner-private math.
`LaserCutRequestDTO` restored to exact XML ABI with padding at 52/56/60; metadata moved out.

`GenerateMockCutterTriggersJob.Schedule(...)+DispatcherJobFence.TryComplete` writes deterministic request+meta rows for isolated editor/CI profiling; force-complete is fenced to `UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD`.
`BuildCutterRaycastsJob` feeds preallocated commands; `RaycastCommand.ScheduleBatch` is registered with `H8Memory`.
`EvaluateCutterRaycastHitsJob` converts hits into SDF/deformation/drain/decal/VFX DTOs with finite guards.
Hull denting is shader/deformation DTO data; no CPU mesh mutation.
Battery drain is staged as unmanaged DTO then `PowerDrainSignal`; no direct inventory mutation.
Glow scar is `LaserCutGlowDecalRequestDTO`; no scar mesh generation.
Spark count uses `math.smoothstep(GlobalQualityWeight)` over tuning `LowSparkCount=0` to `UltraSparkCount=500`; post-evaluation signals forward job-computed `SparkCount` directly.
Cooldown is tick-frame metadata in Vault lanes; duplicate same-frame writes are suppressed.

AUP math subtracts double origins before local float downcast; cutter-adjacent AUP conversion no longer calls `GlobalSignals.CurrentRuntimeOriginAup`; `LaserCutterDodRuntime` consumes cached presentation-origin snapshots and no longer reads `HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffsetDouble` directly.
DTO rows are blittable explicit structs and jobs use `FloatMode.Deterministic`.

300-entry telemetry ring exists with `BatteryWatts@120` and `BurstWorkEstimateMicros@124`; non-finite flags dump `Docs/AgentLogs/Dump_SHINOBU_225.bin` through raw native span export with a 32-byte little-endian header.
UI Toolkit tuner reads tuning/telemetry with frame, heat, battery watts, Burst us estimate, and HitAUP XYZ; mock request frames now use dispatcher frame authority.
CSV parser slices `ReadOnlySpan<byte>` and writes unmanaged spec rows.
Editor gizmo draws red beam, cyan origin, green hit sphere, yellow normal from Vault rows and consumes the cached DOD presentation origin through a pure accessor; missing origin fails closed.

Static report sidecar and shared construction appendix updated with origin-bridge, DOD runtime direct-origin, DOD debug-gizmo direct-origin, WFC dead property accessor, cutter-adjacent property facade, hot managed iteration/text allocation, mock force-complete, DOD runtime DataVault fallback, and explicit secondary diagnosis lookup counters.

Static scans and no-alias/dependency audit written; guarded compile attempt failed on external dependency errors with 0 SHINOBU-owned error paths among files included in Hecton8.Core.csproj. CLI coverage remains incomplete for DOD/WFC runtime files until Unity import regenerates projects.

DTO.name: LaserCutRequestMetaDTO
DTO.Proof: Metadata is one 64-byte row, separated from the mandated request padding and regular for parallel lane writes.

DTO.name: LaserCutTelemetryEntry
DTO.Proof: Stores origin, hit AUP, direction, distance, power, quality, frame, sequence, hashes, flags, heat, state hash, battery watts, and deterministic Burst work estimate.

DTO.name: WfcLaserCutTelemetryEntry
DTO.Proof: 24+24+8+4+4+20+4+2+1+1+4=96; multiple of 32 and exported raw in chronological ring order.

ScalabilityCurve.Low: Spark quantity smoothsteps toward zero; dent/decal radius uses tuning minimum; jobs still execute deterministic truth but shader presentation collapses to cheap glow/deformation parameters.
ScalabilityCurve.Middle: Spark count, decal lifetime, dent radius, and battery watts consume tuning DTO values and rise smoothly; no feature pop or branch tier switch.
ScalabilityCurve.HighUltra: Saved CPU is spent on up to 500 GPU spark/decal requests and larger shader dent radius, not extra CPU simulation.

GlobalSystemsDoctrine.ReadHelper: Resolves only already-created Vault generation handles; no acquire, release, growth, signal publish, job completion, or boot.
Composes ReadBoundBuffer for request/meta/count/cursor/counter lanes only.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.ColdBootstrap: EnsureInitialized binds scheduler/result/telemetry/request/meta lanes and seeds default tuning before hot no-acquire scheduling.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.QualityHandle: Foreign scalability-state handle is cached during cold boot; hot refresh resolves the cached handle or falls back to HomeostasisBrain.GlobalQualityWeight.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.HotRegistryReads: Hot cutter routes consume cached Audio/Input/InteractionSignals/HabitatDeconstruction/SargassumCut/Localization interfaces. Direct registry reads for those services are confined to cold CacheColdDependencies.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.WfcCompileWallBoundary: WfcLaserCutRuntime imports no Hecton8.Power or Hecton8.Logistics.Grid.Contracts, calls no WfcOutpostGridRegistry/WfcOutpostGridLease, and reads no GlobalRegistry.DataVault. LaserCutter cold lifecycle passes IDataVault explicitly; WFC hot route reads bound handles only.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.WfcPropertyBoundary: WfcLaserCutRuntime exposes no dead static `DoorsCutCount` property accessor; the telemetry ring owns cutter-adjacent proof rows.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.CutterPropertyBoundary: LaserCutter and SealedDoor expose no scoped cutter-adjacent public property facades for heat, overheat, pending-count, listener-count, door state, door progress, opened, or can-cut state. Consumers use explicit Read* methods or owner-private math.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.ReadRouteBindingBoundary: Sustained energy/tension/pull reads use ReadCached* helpers and no longer call EnsurePlayerBindings or TryGetComponent. Cold lifecycle/equip owns player binding.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.AdjacentResponderColdCaches: SealedDoor caches IAudioService in Awake/OnEnable and clears on disable/destroy. SargassumCutResponder caches SargassumCutManager in Awake/OnEnable and clears on disable. Route methods consume fields only.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.EventLaneColdBootBoundary: LaserCutterEvents no longer calls GlobalSignals.InitializeAllQueues and no longer bootstraps its lane from Enqueue or FlushPending. Listener/source registration owns cold lane configuration; runtime payload emission fails closed if the typed SignalBus lane was not configured.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.SargassumResponderBoundary: SargassumCutResponder no longer implements ITickable/IUpdatable and no longer calls GlobalRegistry.Dispatcher, TryRegisterUpdatable, or UnregisterUpdatable. The cut mask fact remains owned by SargassumCutManager; debris cooldown is a dispatcher-frame stamp.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.DodSchedulerColdBootBoundary: TryScheduleRaycastBatch now fails closed when IDataVault was not cold-bound and no longer calls EnsureInitialized from the scheduling route.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.DodRuntimeBootBoundary: LaserCutterDodRuntime no longer has an implicit GlobalRegistry.DataVault fallback; boot receives explicit IDataVault from LaserCutter lifecycle or the editor facade.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.AupOriginBoundary: LaserCutter, SealedDoor, and SargassumCutResponder no longer call GlobalSignals.CurrentRuntimeOriginAup in scanned cutter-adjacent conversion routes. Owner phases cache HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffsetDouble into local AUP snapshots.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.DodRuntimeOriginBoundary: LaserCutterDodRuntime scheduling, evaluation, and VFX publication consume `CachePresentationOriginAup` snapshots from the LaserCutter owner phase; invalid samples and runtime rebinds clear cached and scheduled origins. The DOD runtime file contains no direct `HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffsetDouble` reads and no zero-origin presentation fallback.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.DodDebugGizmoOriginBoundary: LaserCutterDodDebugGizmo consumes TryGetPresentationOriginForGizmo and returns without drawing when the cached owner-phase presentation origin is absent.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.MockGeneratorBoundary: GenerateMockCutterTriggers may force-complete only inside UNITY_EDITOR || DEVELOPMENT_BUILD as an editor/CI stress facade.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.TargetRegistryBoundary: TryApplyWfcDoorCut and ProcessDeconstructMode resolve collider ownership through LaserCutterTargetRegistry. SealedDoor and BaseModule register/unregister their colliders from lifecycle; active beam routes no longer call TryGetComponent or GetComponentInParent on target change.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.ExplicitSecondaryDiagnosisBoundary: BuildDiagnosisFromHit resolves salvage module ownership through LaserCutterTargetRegistry and contains no TryGetComponent/GetComponentInParent fallback.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.WfcOwnerPhaseContextBoundary: WFC grid/stress SignalBus snapshots are refreshed by LaserCutter owner phase through RefreshOwnerPhaseContext. TryApplyDoorCut reads cached active-grid and stress scalars only.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.ComponentLookupCache: Component lookup for WFC doors and salvage modules is shifted to lifecycle-owned collider registration, not sustained hit routes.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.SignalBridgeEradication: Focused cutter/door route publishes ToolAcousticSignal, HapticRequest, WfcOutpostStateChangedSignal, LaserCutterEventPayload, DebrisSpawnSignal, VfxSparkRequestSignal, and PowerDrainSignal through typed SignalBus lanes only.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.LegacyStringBoundary: Active HUD/PDA callers use WriteOperational/TryWrite Span and FixedCharBuffer paths. BuildLegacyOperational*String remains as PlayerTool cold compatibility and ToolStackValidator surface and now uses a dedicated cold `_legacyOperationalBuffer`.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.HotManagedCodeBoundary: UsePrimary, ToolTick, cut application, WFC hit, and DOD schedule/evaluate/VFX route windows contain no foreach, LINQ, string.Format, string interpolation, or new string allocation sites. The only focused runtime `new string` hit is the cold legacy compatibility bridge.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.DiagnosisReadBoundary: Operational summary/directive writers no longer call live diagnosis, raycast, or component query. Explicit secondary fire is the owner action; cached byte severity is displayed for a bounded dispatcher-frame window.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.TimeAuthority: Focused cutter, DOD runtime, WFC runtime, sealed-door route, and editor mock generator no longer use Time.time, Time.frameCount, Time.deltaTime, or Time.fixedDeltaTime. Visual jitter remains a triangle-wave fake driven by finite owner-phase delta.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.BlackBoxDumpBoundary: Laser cutter and WFC cutter fault dumps write raw native telemetry spans with stackalloc little-endian headers and entry-size guards, not managed field loops.
GlobalSystemsDoctrine.ValidatorDriftGuard: Static inquisition now counts legacy GlobalSignals.Publish, GlobalSignals.InitializeAllQueues, Unity Time.*, dispatcher frame helpers, cold registry service read sites, legacy string bridge hits, focused LaserCutter new-string bridge sites, hot managed iteration/text allocation sites, completed-fence finalizers, live diagnosis reads, managed diagnosis severity state, BinaryWriter black-box regressions, event Enqueue cold-init sites, SargassumCutResponder runtime registration sites, DOD scheduler cold init, active-route component discovery, DOD debug-gizmo direct origin reads, WFC dead static property accessors, and WFC per-hit snapshot scans.

PointerAliasingAndDependencyGraph.Handles: cooldownHandle -> buildHandle -> scheduledRaycastHandle -> scheduledEvaluationHandle; raycast and evaluation handles are registered through `H8Memory.RegisterActiveJob(SystemID.GameplayTools, handle)` and finalized only when `DispatcherJobFence.TryFinalizeCompleted` succeeds.

CompileGuard.Assembly: No asmdef edited; no sibling runtime assembly reference added. `SealedDoor` no longer imports `Hecton8.Tools` for door VFX and no longer uses `GlobalSignals.Publish` for WFC state. WFC Tools runtime no longer imports Power or Logistics.Grid runtime contracts.
CompileGuard.CoverageCaveat: Generated Hecton8.Core.csproj includes LaserCutter.cs and SealedDoor.cs but omits LaserCutterDodRuntime.cs and WfcLaserCutRuntime.cs, so CLI compile coverage is incomplete until Unity/asmdef import regenerates projects.

Rerun.reason: CPU gate forbids rebuild above 50 percent; previous compile wall is external to SHINOBU_225 and generated Hecton8.Core.csproj omits DOD/WFC runtime files, so rerun would not prove the patched runtime surface without Unity import/project regeneration
